dataset.description: This dataset includes hourly consumption in the Yncrea building for 2 years and 6 month. The data connection is made through energy management system of the building. The building is multi-story with 6 major energy systems. The dataset is used for piloting a solution on the flexible demands in the building showed that there are three major loads including Lighting system, Heat Pump system, and Chauffage Climatization that can contribute to demand-side flexibility, and so, flexibility offer service of InterConnect.

host.description: The data is hosted in the AWS EU region storage, central EU in Frankfort

distribution.available_until: The data will no longer be accessible after the Interconnect open-call project.

dataset.preservation_statement: We preserve it in our secure storage system at AWS S3

security_and_privacy.description: We use all the necessary tools available at our Infrastructure Access Management service on AWS

dataset.title: Yncrea Building

dmp.description:
This DMP is prepared for the French Pilot as part of the InterConnect project open call. For more information regarding this project please reach to https://interconnectproject.eu/pilots/france/ 
In this Pilot Builtrix had access to the energy consumption data of Yncrea Building in city of Toulon. Everything regarding data management is clarified in this report.

project.description: V-Flex is a data-driven software technology built by open-source big data tools and Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms. V-Flex is a Virtual Disaggregation solution which intends to identify the operational state (On/Off) and the precise power consumption of main electrical loads, considering as input only the aggregated consumption from the central smart meter
project.title: VFlex Project as part of InterConnect open call
